entities.name: 2020 COVID-19 pandemic in Samoa
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The COVID-19 pandemic in American Samoa is part of the worldwide pandemic of coronavirus disease 2019 caused by severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2. The COVID-19 pandemic was confirmed to have reached the unincorporated United States territory of American Samoa on November 9, 2020.
